Upstream egui 0.27.2, MIT OR Apache-2.0. Original crate checksum verified against
PocketHLE Cargo.lock. Runtime Options.repaint_on_input (default true, not
serialized) gates automatic input follow-up repaint in src/context.rs and
src/memory.rs. In src/response.rs, tooltip polling while the pointer moves
also respects this option. Image-driven integrations supply their own frame
or fallback updates. Explicit application requests and normal menu repaint
behavior retain their existing semantics. A synthetic hover test covers both
ordinary and image-driven operation.
